title: Grass Field
description: A dense meadow rendered with shell texturing — the fast grass trick Acerola (Garrett Gunnell) breaks down. Rather than drawing every blade, the tilted ground plane is raymarched as a stack of shells, and a fragment is kept only while the shell's height stays under a per-tuft height mask, so each surviving shell is a thinner slice up the blade and the stack tapers into grass. A travelling wind wave with slow gusts sways the blades, stronger toward the tips, and the sun catches them warm at the top while the bases fall into shade; dry blades turn golden and the odd tuft is crowned with a wildflower. Density, wind strength, gustiness, blade height, grass hue, dryness, wildflowers and sun height are live; the pointer parts the grass, and the mic drives the wind.
